name: browser-run-build-isolation
goal: A browser run's built servers answer from the build the run started with: a rebuild of the checkout's build directory during the run cannot turn a refused page into a server error, and a build that is changing when a run starts is named as such

evidence: Independent full check, kept unchanged as work/logs/stage-f-concurrent-500-RED-independent-check.log: in the concurrent browser-run test the second run failed harness-routes.spec.ts:155, an unauthorized console page answered 500 instead of 403, with the server printing [500] GET .../map and undefined. Another full check was building in the same checkout at the time. Three candidates were separated by experiment: an authorization defect, shared generated-build state, a shutdown problem of the test harness.

Reproduced by a controlled experiment in work/stage-f/build-race (experiment.mjs.txt, direct-rebuild.json): a locked built server started from packages/reports/build answers 403 for every address; after bun run build of the same checkout it answers 500 for a page it had not loaded and prints the same two lines, while a control without the rebuild stays at 403. Authorization is not involved: the page's files are loaded before the hook runs. A second experiment showed two builds at once both exit 0 with a different identity every time. Automated red: work/logs/stage-f-frozen-build-red.log, the control test shows the 500 and the two tests of the repair fail.

A run never serves the checkout's build directory: it copies the finished build once into .cache/reports-e2e/<run>/build, where the packages a built server imports resolve, checks the identity of the directory before and after the copy against the copy, and starts its servers from the copy. A missing or changing build stops the run with that reason. Guard: the regression in the package suite, which rebuilds a stand-in for the directory under a server of each kind.

packages/reports: frozenBuild.ts, scripts/freeze-build.ts, e2eFixtures gains the run's build path and removes it with the run, playwright.config.ts starts the three built servers from it, harness-evidence.spec.ts compares the served identity with the run's copy. harness.units.json names the cache path as a known generated reference. README and the feature specification state the boundary: one build or full check per checkout at a time; a verification snapshot has its own.

test/reports-frozen-build.e2e.test.ts 3 passed and packages/reports/test/utils/frozen-build.test.ts 2 passed (work/logs/stage-f-frozen-build-green-1.log). Real trigger: work/stage-f/build-race/frozen-after-repair.json, a server from the run's copy stays at 403 through a real rebuild; run-with-rebuild-midway.log, a real browser run during which the checkout was rebuilt, 14 passed including the page-path refusal.

The guard is the control inside the regression: a server on the directory itself answers 500 once the directory is rebuilt, so serving the directory again fails the second test. On the unchanged configuration the same experiment gives 500 (direct-rebuild.json).

Full bun run check exit 0 (work/logs/stage-f-check-5.log): 445 unit tests with 25 live-API tests skipped, 176 CLI end-to-end tests in 54 files, 30 package tests in 11 files with the 3 index-gated scale tests skipped, 118 reports unit tests in 54 files, cargo checks, both audits, units check 539 units with 15 uncertain references. Browser specs that use the built servers: 18 passed (stage-f-frozen-build-browser.log); concurrent-run test passed. No run directory, build copy or packed server was left. No user-visible flow changed.
